fullDescription: A portrait dark-editorial FILM-FESTIVAL PROGRAM flyer on a warm near-black #111214 field, built on a deliberate THREE-typeface system — Playfair Display for the display voice, a monospace for all times + edge labels (tabular nums), Public Sans for small utility sublabels. A monospace top rail over a hairline rule, a huge Playfair title with the middle word in italic amber #e8a33d, a warm-grey dek, then a hairline-DIVIDED program of rows (mono amber time | Playfair name + Public Sans sublabel | split two-tone pill 'Screen'+'A'), closed by a monospace footer rail. Hairlines divide the lineup instead of boxes; amber #e8a33d is the single accent. All CSS/SVG, no photos. Reusable for film/music/arts festival programs, screening/gig lineups, conference agendas, awards rundowns, and any dark-editorial list-of-times.
prompt:
## Resumo
A portrait (1058x1497, print/poster feel) dark-editorial FILM-FESTIVAL PROGRAM flyer, generically branded as an original shorts festival. WARM NEAR-BLACK CANVAS: the field is #111214 (a few points warm, never pure #000, so it reads editorial not tech-dark), text in warm off-white #f3f1ea, muted grey #8f8b82 for metadata/labels, hairlines and pill-dark in #2c2d30, and ONE accent — amber #e8a33d. DELIBERATE THREE-TYPEFACE SYSTEM, one job each: PLAYFAIR DISPLAY (display serif, up to 900 + italic) for the title and the film names — the voice; a MONOSPACE (SF Mono / ui-monospace / IBM Plex Mono) for ALL metadata — the top rail, every screening time (tabular-nums), the split-pill labels, the footer rail; and PUBLIC SANS (neutral grotesk) for small utility sublabels under each film name. Layout top to bottom: a MONOSPACE top rail split left/right ('VOL. 04 / 2026' | 'RIVERSIDE CINEMA') in muted grey; a hairline #2c2d30 rule; a HUGE Playfair Display title (line-height ~0.94) with the MIDDLE word in ITALIC amber #e8a33d ('Night *Shorts* Festival'); a warm-grey #b8b4aa Public Sans dek (~2 lines); then a PROGRAM of ~4 rows, each a 3-column grid [auto | 1fr | auto] divided by hairline rules top and bottom (NO boxes): a monospace amber #e8a33d time (tabular-nums) | a Playfair film name with a Public Sans muted-grey sublabel beneath | a SPLIT two-tone PILL (a dark #2c2d30 segment 'Screen' + an amber #e8a33d segment 'A'/'B'); then a MONOSPACE footer rail split left/right ('TICKETS $18' | 'NIGHTSHORTS.FEST'). All type + shapes CSS/SVG; no photos, no illustration.

## Estilo Visual
Design a portrait dark-editorial FILM-FESTIVAL PROGRAM flyer. Canvas: warm near-black #111214 (never pure #000), text warm off-white #f3f1ea, metadata muted grey #8f8b82, hairlines #2c2d30, ONE accent amber #e8a33d. Run a DELIBERATE three-typeface system, one job each: PLAYFAIR DISPLAY (display serif, 900 + italic) for the title and film names; a MONOSPACE for ALL metadata (top rail, times with tabular-nums, pill labels, footer rail); PUBLIC SANS for small utility sublabels. Layout: a monospace top rail split left/right over a hairline rule; a HUGE Playfair title (line-height ~0.94) with the MIDDLE word in ITALIC amber; a warm-grey Public Sans dek; then a program of ~4 rows in a 3-column grid [time | name+sublabel | split pill] divided by HAIRLINE rules top and bottom with NO boxes; then a monospace footer rail split left/right. The split pill = a dark #2c2d30 'Screen' segment fused to an amber #e8a33d 'A'/'B' segment. All CSS/SVG, no photos.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Warm near-black field + mono top rail
Fill the portrait canvas with warm near-black #111214 (a few points warm — never pure #000). At the top, a MONOSPACE rail (SF Mono / ui-monospace / IBM Plex Mono) split left and right with space-between, uppercase, tracked, in muted grey #8f8b82: left 'VOL. 04 / 2026', right 'RIVERSIDE CINEMA'. Below it a thin full-width hairline rule in #2c2d30. No photos, no illustration.

### Playfair title with italic-amber middle word
A HUGE display title in PLAYFAIR DISPLAY (weight 900, line-height ~0.94, tight tracking) in warm off-white #f3f1ea, two lines: 'Night [Shorts]' / 'Festival', where the middle word 'Shorts' is set in ITALIC and colored amber #e8a33d as the single flourish. Below it a Public Sans dek in warm grey #b8b4aa (~2 lines, max-width ~86%): 'One evening, nine short films, three countries. Doors at dusk, screenings run back to back.'

### Hairline-divided program rows
A program of ~4 rows, each a CSS grid of three columns [auto | 1fr | auto], vertically centered, with a thin hairline #2c2d30 rule on the top of every row (and the bottom of the last) — NO boxes, NO fills. Column 1: the screening time in MONOSPACE, amber #e8a33d, tabular-nums (e.g. '19:15'). Column 2: the film/block name in PLAYFAIR DISPLAY (warm off-white) with a small PUBLIC SANS muted-grey #8f8b82 sublabel beneath (e.g. 'Opening reel' / 'Curator's pick'). Column 3: a split two-tone pill (see component). Rows: 19:15 Opening reel / Curator's pick — Screen A · 20:00 Documentary block / Four films — Screen A · 21:10 Animation block / Three films — Screen B · 22:00 Awards & Q&A / With the directors — Foyer ·.

### Mono footer rail
At the bottom, a MONOSPACE rail split left and right with space-between, uppercase, tracked, muted grey #8f8b82: left 'TICKETS $18', right 'NIGHTSHORTS.FEST'. Generous air above it.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Deliberate three-typeface system — Three faces, one job each — the coherence engine of the whole flyer.
Assign PLAYFAIR DISPLAY (display serif, 900 + italic) to the VOICE only — the title and the film names. Assign a MONOSPACE (SF Mono / ui-monospace / IBM Plex Mono) to ALL METADATA — the top rail, every screening time (with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums), the pill labels, the footer rail. Assign PUBLIC SANS (neutral grotesk) to small UTILITY sublabels under each name. Never let a face cross into another's job; the one-role-per-face discipline is what keeps the dense lineup legible.

### Hairline-divided program (no boxes) — Program rows separated by thin rules alone, like an editorial index.
Build the program as rows in a 3-column grid [time | name+sublabel | pill], each separated by a thin hairline rule (#2c2d30) on top (and bottom on the last row) — NO card backgrounds, NO borders around cells, NO fills. The hairlines alone structure the lineup so it reads as a printed index, not a table.

### Split two-tone pill — One pill fusing venue + slot in two colors.
Build a split PILL as an inline-flex with overflow hidden and a small radius: a LEFT segment in dark #2c2d30 with warm-off-white monospace text ('Screen' / 'Foyer'), fused to a RIGHT segment in amber #e8a33d with near-black #111214 bold monospace text ('A' / 'B' / '·'). The two fused segments pack venue + slot into one compact component; amber appears only here and on the time and the italic title word.

### Warm near-black editorial canvas — A few points of warmth in the darkest tone for a printed, premium feel.
Use warm near-black #111214 for the field (never pure #000), warm off-white #f3f1ea for primary text, muted grey #8f8b82 for metadata, and #2c2d30 for hairlines and the pill's dark segment. The warmth is what makes the piece read editorial and physical rather than tech dark-mode.

## Notas Especiais
THREE FACES, ONE JOB EACH IS THE SYSTEM: Playfair Display = voice (title + names); monospace = ALL metadata (rails, times, pill labels); Public Sans = small utility sublabels. Load Playfair Display (400/700/900 + italic) and Public Sans (300/400/600/700) from Google Fonts; the mono is the system stack ('SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace) — substitute IBM Plex Mono / Space Mono if a served webfont is required, but keep it a true monospace with tabular figures.,WARM near-black #111214, never pure #000. Text warm off-white #f3f1ea (not #fff). One accent only: amber #e8a33d, allowed on exactly three things — the screening times, the italic middle title word, and the pill's slot segment.,HAIRLINES DIVIDE, BOXES DON'T: program rows are separated by #2c2d30 hairline rules alone — no card backgrounds, no cell borders, no fills. Times use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so the mono column aligns.,NO real external reference was sourced (matching galleries were Cloudflare-walled); this is a NEW composition anchored to [[DP-1319]] (pudding.cool) and [[DP-1302]] (press.stripe.com) corpus lineage. No `DP-1806-ref.png` was created — inventing a reference image would violate the pipeline's iron rule.,Canvas is fixed 1058x1497 portrait (1cqw = 10.58px if authoring in container units). Swap copy/lineup freely — the structure (mono rail / Playfair title with accent word / dek / hairline rows with split pills / mono footer) holds for any festival program, gig/screening lineup, conference agenda, awards rundown, or gallery-night schedule.
